text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the owner(s) of 403 Keewatin Avenue for a site-specific Fence Exemption, pursuant to the Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447- Fences. The property owner(s) is seeking Council's permission to be exempt from Chapter 447–3 E(c) - Having element or attachment between 100 millimetres and 1.2 metres above grade that may facilitate climbing the outside of the enclosure, contrary to Section 447-3 of the bylaw. The subject property 403 Keewatin Avenue is located in Ward 25, on a residentially zoned property.

North York Community Council: 1. Granted the application by the owner(s) of 403 Keewatin Avenue for the rear yard fence with climbable elements, which totals 2 metres in height with climbable elements, without conditions. 2. Directed and requires that the installation be maintained in good repair without alteration. 3. Directed and requires that at such time as replacement of the fence is required that such installation will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, or its successor by-law.
